prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-pair-01
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): d1632b9212e2d748
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback read via reg_dat_do returned 0xff instead of expected 0xa5 because recv_buf_valid never asserted so data fell back to ~0. Reset loads send_pattern with ~1 so ser_tx=send_pattern[0] is 0 instead of idle 1, injecting a false start on loopback. The receiver desynchronizes and misses the real 0xa5 frame.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash d1632b9212e2d748 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
